note: Derived from 7 untouched live-spectate baseline runs (docs/FIXED-DEFINITION.md): 17-55 hitches/min, worst 1.7-3.3 s, 0.1% low 0.8-1.6 fps; vs fixed runs 1.8-3.0 hitches/min, worst <=33 ms, 0.1% low 46-54 fps.

no_steady_periodic.description: No significant periodic component at any period < 10 s (spec: steady rhythm < 10 s).

sparse_rate_per_min_max.description: Sparse hitch rate must be <= value, and never above absolute_cap, per run.

fps_0p1pct_low_min.description: 0.1% low >= 30 fps (baseline 0.8-1.6 fps; fixed runs 46-54 fps in heavy teamfights).

min_run_duration_min.description: Every run must be >= 5 min after warm-up (sparse verdicts need >= 5 min).

min_consecutive_runs.description: The 'fixed' claim requires this many consecutive runs, including one 15-20 min.

hitches_per_min_max.description: Primary-tier hitches/min <= value (baseline >= 17/min; fixed runs <= 3.0/min in heavy late-game scenes).

worst_hitch_ms_max.description: No hitch above 100 ms (baseline worst 1.7-3.3 s; fixed runs <= 33 ms).

longest_run_min.description: At least one of the consecutive runs must be 15-20 min after warm-up.
